fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and election aftermath coverage regarding Miami city commissioners and related disputes, along with editorials on law enforcement practices (including gun-toting and beach policing) and criticism of municipal and county actions such as bond indebtedness and Miami Beach charter/annexation questions. Considerable space is devoted to welcoming and entertaining visiting Lions for an upcoming convention, with tourism and nightlife guidance, advertisements, and event promotions for Miami and Miami Beach.
